bifurcation.name: Consumer apps
bifurcation.blurb: Co-Star, Nebula, The Pattern, Sanctuary — B2C attention machines. They fight each other for the same 6% of weekly engagers and monetize with paywalls the app-store reviews despise. None of them equips a practitioner.

bifurcation.name: Calculation APIs
bifurcation.blurb: Prokerala, AstrologyAPI — the ephemeris layer, sold by the credit. Excellent at computation, indifferent to practice. They're our suppliers before they're our competitors — and the ones to watch if they move up-stack.

bifurcation.name: Practitioner infrastructure
bifurcation.blurb: Nobody owns “Shopify + voice model + compliance + attestation” for Western spiritual practitioners. The closest structural analog is what SimplePractice did for therapists. That's the seat we're taking.

rows.name: Co-Star
values: A quarter of young US women 18–25 installed it — the demand core is real
Nothing for practitioners; AI-generated content only

rows.name: Nebula (OBRIO)
values: Blended AI + live consults monetize at real scale
Marketplace-first; readers are supply, not customers

rows.name: CHANI
values: “All-human, zero-AI” commands willingness to pay — our thesis, proven by someone else
One brand, one astrologer; not infrastructure

rows.name: Sanctuary
values: Signs of stagnation; readers gig for the platform's brand

rows.name: AstroTalk
values: Verified-practitioner marketplaces reach venture scale — and content moderation is material to valuation
India-centric, consumer-brand-first; practitioners don't own the relationship

rows.name: Prokerala · AstrologyAPI
values: The calculation layer is a solved, licensable commodity
No voice, no attestation, no compliance, no commerce

rows.name: Patreon · Circle · Kajabi
values: Won't build ephemeris cores, tradition corpora, or attestation — the vertical depth is the moat

rows.name: SimplePractice
values: One founder's vertical-SaaS insight can dominate a fragmented solo-professional market

rows.name: DOGM.AI
values: Sell readings direct to consumers. Ever. That discipline is the moat.
